<!-- Generated by npm run design-system:sync from components/design-system/ListFilters.md. Edit that file, not this one. -->
The tools above a list: filters, the chips for filters that are on, and the bar that appears when rows can be selected.

- `.filter-bar` lays labelled selects and inputs in a wrapping row (the form is a plain GET form, so filters live in the address and "Clear filters" resets them); `.filter-bar-actions` holds Apply or Search and Clear filters. `.filter-field` is a select with its label inside the border.
- Active filters are chips: each is a pill with the filter in words and a 44px "×" link that removes only that filter, followed by a "Clear filters" link. The chip row is a list named "Active filters".
- `.selection-bar` (on a `.panel`) is the select-all bar of a list with tick boxes. With nothing ticked it says "Tick registrations to email them, or use Select all." with a purple `.text-button` "Select all 24 shown"; once rows are ticked it shows the count in bold and adds Clear selection and the bulk action as `.secondary-button.outline-action` with a 16px icon. The count is a `role="status"` line.
- The same bar is used for approvals, invitations and the People list; only the wording of its actions changes.
